context: Number the ground 0. Each move climbs 1 or 2 stairs, and the goal is to land exactly on stair 3.
description: The stairs are numbered 0 through 6 from left to right. The tread of stair 3 is green. Three sets of arcs above the same staircase correspond to the stair sequences below. The caption reads, “There are 3 ways to reach stair 3.”

frames.explanation: The solid teal route 0→1→2→3 climbs 1 stair three times. The dotted blue route 0→2→3 climbs 2 stairs to stair 2 and then 1 to stair 3. The dashed orange route 0→1→3 climbs 1 stair to stair 1 and then 2 to stair 3. Climbing 2 then 1 and climbing 1 then 2 visit different stairs and count as distinct routes.
frames.title: Three ways to reach stair 3

summary: Three paths show different ways to reach stair 3.
title: Three ways to reach stair 3
